name: stage2-prep-v2
title: Stage 2 palette-cycling phase exports from the prep-v1 index masters (cell-isolated)
state: predicted-static; import only after live capture confirms the key (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate on the AQ-01/AQ-03 Stage 2 capture)
method:
W7-STAGE2 index masters: one CLUT-free master per 4bpp page, rendered through any CLUT.

Master (8 px/texel = the 2048 export grid; CPU only, deterministic, no AI, nothing added):
  categorical layer  top-3 (label, weight u8) per pixel: for every native index i the one-hot mask is upsampled
                     texel-centred (bilinear), gaussian-smoothed (sigma_cat texels) and raised to power_cat, then
                     normalised (w7-stage7 build_s7 / w4-world catsoft method). It carries the class (alpha) of ANY
                     CLUT: class = class of the strongest visible label where visible weight >= 0.5, else 0, so every
                     CLUT gets its own native class map with smooth contours.
  continuous layer   t (float16, NaN elsewhere) inside regions whose drawn CLUTs are monotone luminance ramps over the
                     indices used there (palette-cycling lights, smoke and flame ramps): normalised convolution of the
                     native index over the texels that are visible in that region (bilinear texel-centred upsample,
                     gaussian sigma_t texels); render = lerp(P[floor t], P[ceil t]) (index_pipeline convention), t
                     clamped to the CLUT's visible run.
Render(CLUT) -> RGBA at 8 px/texel; the native class is then forced at every native texel centre floor((i+0.5)*s)
(one pixel each, w6/w7 rule) and every export is re-read and validated (0 mismatches required).
Regions come from the Stage 2 draw records (work/draws-s2.json): every drawn uv rect of every key of the page whose CLUT
words are known (static export CLUT or CRC-validated recovered phase).
builder_doc:
W7-STAGE2 builder: Stage 2 art on exact-static TEX from the shared static export.

    python -I build_s2.py <family> [freeze]      family = prep | sky | train | fx
    -> staging/<name>/ (default) or frozen/<name>/ (freeze: immutable, refuses to overwrite)

State of every key: predicted-static; import only after live capture confirms the key (validate_predicted.py confirm +
gate on the AQ-01/AQ-03 Stage 2 capture).  Words come from static-extraction/stages/stage2/textures/<TEX>.words.bin
(crc32 == TEX re-checked); CLUT words from the export's cluts.json or, for palette-cycling phases, from
work/recovered-cluts.json (CRC-validated marked CPU-VRAM snapshots of runs 153406/155355); crc32 == PAL re-checked.
Exports only for keys actually drawn in the Stage 2 window (work/draws-s2.json) whose CLUT words are known.
Method: s2master.py (CLUT-free index master; categorical + continuous layers; class forced and validated at every
native texel centre).  CPU only, deterministic; no generated imagery; nothing invented (no new text, colours or pixels
outside the native index layout).  The Japanese mission-text page 9E88006F (1/40) is not touched.

review.note: native | HD: full page at 2 px/texel, a 16x crop, and the busiest drawn rect at 9 screen px per texel (2160-line in-game size) labelled SIMULATION (bilinear RGB, nearest class, no mips; semi-1 keys composited additively on dark navy).

class_validation.rule: class at every native texel centre floor((i+0.5)*scale) == classes(CLUT)[words] (0 = 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque); every export re-read from disk

known_limits: CPU index masters: the continuous layer is a smooth reconstruction of the native index ramp (no generated detail); the light strips and ring segments are flat-shaded native shapes, so smooth gradients and clean contours are the expected HD look
only the phases with known CLUT words are exported (static export CLUT or CRC-validated snapshot); the other phases render from the same master once AQ-01 captures their CLUT words
the panel regions of 3DD37B6B / AD934A7E use the categorical layer (contour smoothing, exact native colours); they are not exported here (vehicle/enemy family)
masters, palette-phase inventory and the AQ-01 capture addendum are in stage2-prep-v1 (unchanged)
honest_read: Light strips (3DD37B6B @96,484): the pixel staircases of the bent strips become clean curves and the brightness steps along each strip become a continuous gradient; strip ends become rounded (slightly bulbous where the native end is a 1-texel step). Ring segments (AD934A7E @128,484): clean contours; three of the four known phases are near-black in native and HD alike, so they show little. Good as a motion-safe base; it is a reconstruction, not new detail. v2 exports are cell-isolated (no neighbour bleed at the drawn-cell edges).
